corrections.reason: The printed glyph is 'ጸ' in 'ጸጋው' ('his grace was taken from him'), misread as 'ኦጋው' due to ink fill in the upper loops of 'ጸ'.
Continuation of 'እንዲ↵ታወቅ' ('so that it may be known') from line 24; the printed glyph at the start of line 25 is 'ታ', misread as 'ባ'.
Classical Ge'ez plural '፫ቱ ዕድወኒሁ ለሰብእ' ('the three enemies of man', explained in lines 30-31 as sin, death, and condemnation); the final glyph is 'ወ' wrapping mid-word to 'ኒሁ' on line 30.

corrections.old_text: ልድ ።⟫ ፩ ነገ ፲፥፩ ፤ ፪ ዜና ፱ ፥ ፩ ።
corrections.corrected_text: ልድ ።⟫ ፩ ነገ ፲፥፩ ፤ ሕፁ ፱ ፥ ፩ ።
corrections.reason: The printed citation uses the traditional Ge'ez abbreviation 'ሕፁ' (ሕፅፅ, Paralipomenon/Chronicles), which was misread as '፪ ዜና'.
The printed word is 'ከባድ' ('ከባድ ገጸ በረከት', a heavy/precious gift), where 'ከ' was misread as 'ገ'.
3rd person feminine singular verb with 3rd person masculine object suffix is printed 'ጠይቃዋለች' (4th-order 'ቃ', 'she asked him'), and the Ge'ez relative prefix 'ዘ' wraps to 'ኢፈከረ' on line 39.
